title: Cad Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 📐️cad plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/) from V1 taxonomy shape to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14. Move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, fold sibling variant files (🎛️apps/📐️cad/🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs, 🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/🦀️interaction_spec.rs, and any others found in inventory) into their own component folders, verify data/docs already sit at owner root, and confirm zero test-count drift. Scope strictly limited to 🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/, 🎛️apps/📐️cad/, 📦️lib.rs, 📦️packages/🦀️rust/, and owner-root data/doc files — leave 🔨️modules/* and 🧩️extensions/* entirely untouched.
summary: Retrofitted the already-V1-migrated 📐️cad plugin to Shape V2 tree purity per TEMPLATE.md §14, purely mechanical (no logic changes, no wire-format risk). (1) Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs; updated Cargo.toml's [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs"; prefixed all 38 #[path] strings with "../../". (2) Folded 8 sibling variant files into their own component folders (module identifiers unchanged, only #[path]/location moved): 🎛️apps/📐️cad/🦀️config.rs→🧮️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs→🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs→🕸️wasm/🦀️component.rs, 🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/🦀️interaction_spec.rs→🎬️interaction-spec/🦀️component.rs, ⚙️engine/🦀️construct.rs→🔍️construct/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️geometry_import.rs→📥️geometry-import/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️interaction.rs→🕹️interaction/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️transformation.rs→🔄️transformation/🦀️component.rs (the last 4 discovered via inventory beyond the dispatch note's list — engine/'s topic files were also sibling variants). (3) Fixed a real bug the moves introduced: 3 of the folded files (interaction-spec, geometry-import, interaction) used include_str!() with paths relative to the FILE's own disk location (unlike #[path], not auto-adjusted) — each moved one directory level deeper, so every include_str! target needed one more "../" prefix (66 call sites across 3 files); verified every target resolves and confirmed the two untouched files using include_str! (engine/component.rs, dsl/component.rs) and the one CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR-anchored path (interaction-spec's env! lookup) were unaffected since they didn't move / aren't file-relative. (4) Fixed 3 stale doc-comment path references pointing at old sibling-file locations. (5) Verified owner-root data/docs (AGENTS.md, README.md, 📚️examples/, 🧫️fixtures/, 🖼️assets/, 🧬️schema/) already correctly placed, none nested in the tree — no changes needed. Verification: cargo check clean (0 cad warnings), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings exit 0 (0 cad warnings), cargo test --lib 125/125 passed (matches V1 baseline exactly, zero drift), cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 clean — all via a temporary [workspace] overlay on the crate's own Cargo.toml (root workspace-wide cargo blocked by the documented in-flight 📕️norm dangling-manifest issue, unrelated to this retrofit), overlay fully removed after verification, confirmed Cargo.toml diffs back to exactly the one intended [lib] path change. Final find confirms 🗿️artifacts/ and 🎛️apps/ contain nothing but 🦀️component.rs files and plain folders. 🔨️modules/* and 🧩️extensions/* confirmed completely untouched (git status clean). No registrar handoff needed — the 3 external Cargo.toml dependents (dsl fixture-sweep, demonstrator, lowpoly) all reference the crate directory (unchanged), not the internal lib.rs path; only an nx file-map cache entry (self-correcting) still shows the old path. Noted but did not touch: 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts shows a one-line import-depth change from an apparent concurrent session, unrelated to this retrofit.
